import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

# Calculate yt/angler for d265-d275 by class
trips_df = tables['trips']
trips_recent = trips_df[(trips_df['fish_date_doy'] >= 265) & (trips_df['fish_date_doy'] <= 275)]

# Group by fish_date_doy and cls, calculate yt/angler
daily_class = trips_recent.groupby(['fish_date_doy', 'cls']).agg({
    'yt': 'sum',
    'anglers': 'sum'
}).reset_index()
daily_class['yt_per_angler'] = daily_class['yt'] / daily_class['anglers']

# Pivot for easier viewing
pivot = daily_class.pivot(index='fish_date_doy', columns='cls', values='yt_per_angler').round(3)
result = pivot.sort_index(ascending=False)
